goodnews.h: Free legal clinic for former Lozano Kennedy clients
goodnews.b: The L.A. Law Library will host a free clinic Saturday for clients who believe they may be victims of fraud or misconduct by the former immigration lawyer or her firm.
goodnews.title: Former clients of immigration lawyer Alexandra Lozano Kennedy can get free legal help in LA

local.h: Queens driver indicted in stroller crash that killed baby
local.b: Prosecutors say Elvin Rivera ran a stop sign in Flushing on cocaine and THC and struck 1-year-old Justin Hu.
local.title: Intoxicated Queens driver killed baby after running stop sign, indictment says

local.h: Penn Station plan could fund a new MSG venue
local.b: Amtrak's overhaul would buy and demolish the Infosys Theater, and MSG says sale money could pay for a new venue.
local.title: Amtrak's Penn Station plan could funnel taxpayer money to new venue for James Dolan

local.h: Google, NYC schools clash over AI ban
local.b: Google said schools that ban AI will lose access to its search, and Mayor Mamdani accused it of using monopoly power to force AI into classrooms.
local.title: NYC schools’ standoff with Google over AI raises prospect of no search in class

local.h: Supreme Court case could limit specialized school reforms
local.b: Experts say a challenge to a Maryland county's magnet school admissions could narrow Mayor Mamdani's options for admitting more Black and Latino students.
local.title: Supreme Court case could affect admissions reforms for NYC specialized schools

local.h: Two found shot dead at East Harlem senior center
local.b: Police found a 55-year-old woman and a 66-year-old man at a NYCHA complex Thursday night and are investigating whether it was a murder-suicide.
local.title: Health aide, elderly man killed in East Harlem senior center shooting, per NYPD

local.h: South Bronx, East New York lead in low-level tickets
local.b: A John Jay College analysis found more than 60% of NYPD loitering summonses since 2025 came from one South Bronx precinct.
local.title: South Bronx, East New York lead NYC in littering and panhandling tickets, analysis finds

local.h: Lawyers to sue interior minister over protest injuries
local.b: Attorneys said they will target Laurent Nunez over what they call police mutilations of protesters during weeks of student-led demonstrations.
local.title: French lawyers to sue interior minister over protester 'mutilations'

local.h: Four flights diverted in France after bomb threats
local.b: Three landed at Orly and one at Bordeaux without incident as investigators look for the source of alerts hitting flights across Europe.
local.title: LATEST: Four new bomb threats on flights over France

local.h: Bomb hoaxes disrupt flights across Europe
local.b: About 20 flights were affected Thursday alone. No government has said who is responsible, though experts suspect hybrid warfare.
local.title: Who is behind the bomb hoaxes hitting flights across Europe?

local.h: Police to stand trial over 2020 beating of Michel Zecler
local.b: The CCTV-recorded assault fuelled outrage over police violence. 'I expect this trial to hold the police officers accountable,' he said.

local.h: Two Paris marches planned for Saturday
local.b: Major unions and the Yellow Vests have both called demonstrations in Paris on Nov. 7 after a week of school blockades and a national strike.

goodnews.h: France's new TGV-M trains finally launch
goodnews.b: After years of delays, the double-decker trains began running Paris to Marseille Friday, with 20% more seats and 20% lower energy use.
goodnews.title: Bar carriage, bike spaces and phone holder: Inside France's new TGV-M trains
